fix.commit: fb3b824 on branch no-empty-selections in worktree C:\Users\shubh\Projects\BibleAtlas-empty, built from origin/main 2aabdcc (main had moved past b6d7f1e when PR #50 merged; that PR changed only config/layers.json and docs). Not pushed. Subject: "Every line and pick under a verse now opens on something to read". 17 files changed, 986 insertions, 52 deletions. web/src/ui/extras/voices/Panel.tsx and voices/model.ts are not touched, so this cannot conflict with commentary-notice.
fixed: Christian writers (the founder's report): a Wesley note with fewer than 25 letters of its own, after removing references and words that only point, is now left out (extra_voices.rs build(), using own_letters and note_letters). Exactly 522 notes were dropped: 282 that were only a reference and 240 short glosses. So the line no longer names Wesley on Matthew 6:14, Mark 1:3 or Genesis 26:10. The case left the short glosses to the owner. I chose to drop them because the founder's examples included them, and most explain KJV words the BSB does not use. To keep a gloss only when another writer also has a note on the verse, change the retain() in build().

Henry pointer notes: a chapter note that only says 'See II Kin. ...' or 'This chapter is the same as II Kin. ...' (pointed_to, plus a new pass in henry()) now shows the pointer as a link, followed by Henry's own notes on the passage it names. Isaiah 36 gets 2 Kings 18:17-37, Isaiah 39 gets 2 Kings 20:12-19, and Isaiah 37, which had no line before, gets all of Henry's notes on 2 Kings 19. book_token now reads 'I', 'II' and 'III' before a book name. A new numbered_links step turns 11 plain-text references like 'II Kin.' and 'I Pet.' into links.

Study notes: a note that only sends the reader elsewhere is now left out of the build (402 notes). Examples: 'See Exodus 28:1-43.', 'Peleg: See the study note on 10:25.', 'Will I recover? See ...', 'See ... Theme Note'. This is done by pointer() and shown_text() in extra_notes.rs. Exodus 39:1-31 and Genesis 21:1-2 no longer show a notes line.

Old Bible dictionaries: an entry with fewer than 25 letters of its own (after removing references, brackets and 'See X' parts) is no longer listed under a verse (307 entries). If such a stub names exactly one other entry in the same dictionary that has real content, that entry is listed in its place (106 cases). For example, Genesis 8:22 now lists Agriculture and Month instead of Seasons. Smith's Anchor and Mallows are gone. 11 verses no longer have the line. The panel's opening sentence now says 'An entry ... for {verse}. It was written ...', and the Deep facts explain the rule.

Places: a verse where the map can mark none of its places is left out of the 'at' list in extras/real-map.json. drawn() matches the logic of places.ts info() and proposals(). This removes the line from 35 verses: the Holy Place verses, Tarshish, Zarephath and others.

Parallels: the build now adds an 'alone' list to extras/parallels.json: the 915 verses whose row has no partner verse in any compared passage. On those verses the line reads 'This passage is also told in ...' (or the matching wording for songs, lists, laws, prophecies and letters) instead of 'Also told in ...'. No verse loses its line. This was also left to the owner; I chose rewording over hiding the line because the row matching is a heuristic and would otherwise hide true parallels such as Genesis 5:1-4 with 1 Chronicles 1:1-4.

Links tab (Connections.tsx): a verse with no links now shows only itself, its original words, and its themes or layers. There is no 'Linked to 0', no empty heading and no neighborhood button. At Deep, 'Show N weak or disputed links' still appears when there are any. The neighborhood note now says '1 verse' in the singular.

Map (AtlasMap.tsx): a new linkedAt() picks the verse under the pointer if it has links. Otherwise it picks the closest verse with links within 8 px (16 px for touch), or nothing, in which case the selection is kept and no tip shows. This applies to both hover and tap. The tip also says '1 link' in the singular.

Verses the BSB leaves out: the reader row and the Links tab now say 'The BSB does not include this verse in its main text; some manuscripts add it.' (the OMITTED constant in common.tsx). The Passage card in kit.tsx, which the Syriac panel also uses, now says 'Some manuscripts add a verse here.' This is a one-line change to a spine file.

Ask (AskSheet.tsx): an empty verse ('') now means the verse is not in the BSB, not that it is still loading, so Acts 8:37 shows 'Some manuscripts add a verse here.' instead of '...' that never resolves.

Ask line (ask.extra.tsx): when a verse has only one question, its panel opens that question at once with openAsk inside useLayoutEffect, so there is no one-item list. The list stays when there are two or more questions.

Search (search.ts, Palette.tsx): a query written in Hebrew or Greek letters, with no Latin letters, is now matched against each lemma's own spelling, ignoring vowel points, accents and breathings and treating final sigma like sigma. Such a query skips the English search, so the 'No verse uses' note no longer appears for it. When nothing matches, a plain note suggests trying the transliteration. The tokenizer (WORD) is unchanged, so it still matches english.rs.
